integration_issues.issue: useEvidenceManagement.handleDeleteExistingEvidence/handleDeleteAllEvidences derives file id only from URL regex instead of preferring persisted file_id. If URL shape changes, DELETE /api/files/{id} may be skipped.

action_items: Update useEvidenceManagement delete paths to prefer evidence.file_id fallback before URL parsing, matching EmissionEntryForm behavior.
Run one focused UI retest for sinks/facilities/esg evidence delete-failure retention after frontend patch.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend R2 cleanup paths are green on live environment for targeted scenarios. Remaining work is frontend hook consistency: file_id-first deletion in useEvidenceManagement and quick UI retest for delete-failure retention behavior.
rca of the issue: Root cause for remaining frontend contract gap: useEvidenceManagement stores file_id on upload but delete routines rely on URL regex extraction for existing evidences. This creates fragility if evidence URLs are transformed or not in /api/files/{id} format. Mitigation: use evidence.file_id first, then URL regex as fallback; keep current early-return behavior on storage deletion failure to preserve UI item.
